evidence: Bounded static search of one mapped image; negative results are not lifetime proof
limitations: RIP-relative operands to this exact global only; derived pointers, aliases, bulk stores and encoded addresses are not covered.
Direct E8/E9 branches only; indirect calls, encoded dispatch and runtime-generated or absent code are not covered.
Instruction boundaries for anchored results follow exception metadata and linear decoding; fragmented functions may be missed.
Unanchored decodes include overlapping prefix alternatives and are candidates, not distinct confirmed instructions.
No writer found does not imply immutable storage, permanent ownership or safe queue publication.
